description: domOS Aalborg Living Lab: Indoor Climate and District Heating Control Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Henrik Staermose, Thomas Pedersen. This dataset has been collected in context of the domOS H2020 project (https://www.domos-project.eu/). The dataset includes data about 147 family homes of which 144 are flats in 12 building blocks and the rest are single family buildings. All buildings are owned by a building association, and are heated via the local district heating company. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is restricted according to the metadata; the conditions were not read. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
